senses.gloss: (b. h.) spark, sparkling light. Tanḥ. Vayesheb 1 נ׳ אחד וכ׳ one spark from thy smithy.—Pl. נִיצוֹצוֹת, נִיצוֹצִים, נִיצוֹצִין.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:3">Tosef. Yoma II, 3</cite> <he>היו נ׳ יוצאות ממנה</he> sparkling rays proceeded from it (the golden tablet); <cite ref="Yoma 37b:2">Yoma 37ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ יוצאין</he>; Y. ib. III, 41ᵃ top <he>הנ׳ מנתזין</he>; Y. Sot. II, 18ᵃ top <he>הניצוצים וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:1">Num. R. s. 5</cite>, beg. <he>שני נ׳ של אש וכ׳</he> two sparks of fire &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:1">Ib.</cite> <he>שני נצ׳ מקדמין וכ׳</he> two sparks preceded them.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:15:4">Y. Ab. Zar. V, end, 45ᵇ</cite> (v. <cite ref="L00413"><he>לִיבּוּן</he></cite>) <he>צריך שיהא נ׳ וכ׳</he> it must be so heated that sparks burst forth from it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:2">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:2">VII</cite>), 2 <he>נפלו הימנו נ׳ ואמר וכ׳</he> if snuff falls off the candle, and he says, we shall have guests &c. (v. <cite ref="A02007"><he>אֱמוֹרִי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:6">Sabb. III, 6</cite> <he>לקבל נ׳</he> to receive the snuff; a. fr.

<cite ref="Shabbat 88b:3">Sabb. 88ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 34a:12">Snh. 34ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 23:29">Jer. XXIII, 29</cite>) <he>מה פטיש זה מתחלק לכמה נ׳</he> as the sledge-hammer (when shattered by the harder rock) is divided into many shivers (differ. in commentaries).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 76b:1">Ab. Zar. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>מה בולעו נ׳ וכ׳</he> as the rim of a caldron absorbs forbidden substances through squirtings, so does it emit them again through the squirtings (of the boiling cleansing water, v. <cite ref="C00785"><he>גִּיעוּל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Niddah 13a:33">Nidd. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ נתזין וכ׳</he> drippings (of urine) squirt upon his feet.

<cite ref="Shabbat 139b:18">Sabb. 139ᵇ</cite> <he>האיכא נ׳</he> but there is the residue (the last drops percolating through the dregs in emptying liquid from vessel to vessel); <he>נ׳ לבי ר׳ וכ׳</he> that residue was not cared about in the house of &c.
